Answer ID: 2528 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1426/1256=B) If it is unavoidable to have home, or you do not have money or you have money but face legal problems from government then in case of necessity and exigency it is allowable to take loan from bank according to the rule: الضرورات تبیح المحظورات Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
